title: C++ foundations
description: Tolliver Clockworks is a small workshop that repairs clocks and watches, and its repair tickets, parts and prices are still worked out by hand on paper slips. You are its new developer and have never written code, so you start by building your first program and move the slips onto the laptop one idea at a time, reading what the compiler tells you on the way. Each issue teaches one part of C++, from your first line through values, numbers and their traps, and text, then decisions, loops, functions, references and reading what people type, then lists with vectors, look-ups with maps and the standard algorithms, in one file you build, run and check yourself.
